outputs.explanation: Panel shows a single representative spatial-transcriptomic cluster map from 'a SNL lung section' (singular). No averaged/quantified data derived from multiple replicates is presented, so replicate reporting does not apply.
H&E image and manual region annotation of the single lung section introduced in panel A; a single specimen is depicted, not aggregated/replicated data, so no replicate number is expected.
Spatial expression overlays (Tmprss11b, Trp63, Hnf4a) are shown on the same single annotated section; this is a single-specimen visualization, not a quantitative summary over replicates.

replicate_statements: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) from T11b-high versus low squamous tumors (S1&S2 versus S3) with normalized enrichment scores (NES), false discovery rate (FDR) and P values
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations
outputs.explanation: The GSEA compares groups of spatial spots/regions (S1&S2 vs S3) and reports statistics (NES, FDR, P), implying replicated observations underlying each group, but the caption never states how many spots, regions, or biological samples (e.g., mice/sections) made up each compared group. The '1000 permutations' describes the statistical resampling method for significance testing, not the number or type of biological/technical replicates.

replicate_statements: Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat's FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat's FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: The bar graph reports DEGs between Tmprss11b-high and -low LUSC groups with P values from a Wilcoxon rank-sum test, indicating the comparison is based on multiple underlying observations (e.g., spatial spots) per group, but the caption does not state the number of spots/samples per group or what type of replicate (spot, region, animal) these represent.
